description: This file contains build definitions and macros for building Chromium OS images for specific Google hardware devices, particularly the Google WiFi (Gale) on QCA IPQ4019 SoC. It defines build steps for copying and preparing kernel images, signing kernels with device-specific boot utilities, and assembling device images with specified packages.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Defines a build rule to copy the current target into a temporary file and then append it to the target, handling possible errors.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Defines a build step to append the kernel image to the target image using dd with the specified kernel partition size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Signs the kernel image for Chromium OS with the device-specific boot utility, replacing the file atomically.

methods.name: Device/google_wifi
methods.description: Defines device-specific build parameters, including vendor, model, SOC, kernel suffix, kernel image processing pipeline, package dependencies, and the image composition pipeline.
